normal.en: The adverb peripherally works like central and centrally, so the family swaps neatly.
normal.cn: 副词 peripherally 与 central、centrally 的变化方式相同，整组词可以整齐互换。

abstract.en: Draw a bullseye and colour only the outer ring.
abstract.cn: 画一个靶心圆，只给最外面那一圈涂色。

abstract.en: Stand in the middle of a field and imagine a distant ring of houses.
abstract.cn: 站在田地中央，想象远处有一圈房子。

abstract.en: Picture a laptop with a crowd of wires and devices gathered around it.
abstract.cn: 想象一台笔记本电脑，线和各种设备在它四周聚成一团。

examples.en: She noticed a shadow at the edge of her peripheral vision.
examples.cn: 她注意到余光边缘有一道影子。

examples.en: Many rural districts remain peripheral to the national economy.
examples.cn: 许多乡村地区在全国经济中仍处于边缘位置。

examples.en: The committee treated the question as peripheral to its main task.
examples.cn: 委员会认为这个问题与主要任务关系不大。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泼瑞佛罗」——想象往佛的身旁「泼」水，水花溅到了边缘一圈；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 peri（周围）+ pherein（携带、运转）→ periphereia（圆周）→ 晚期拉丁语 peripheria → 英语 periphery → 形容词 peripheral，核心义「绕在中心外的一圈」。

sensesIntro.en: Peripheral starts with the physical outer ring, passes through vision, computers and regions, and ends with the weaker sense of being of minor importance.
sensesIntro.cn: peripheral 从实在的外圈说起，经过视野、电脑配件和地区，最后落到「次要、无关紧要」这一较虚的义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the ring drawn around a centre point.
core.cn: 核心意象：围着中心点画出的那一圈。

branches.en: The plain spatial sense is the literal ring.
branches.cn: 最基本的空间义就是字面上的那圈边缘。

branches.en: Computer devices hang on the ring around the processor.
branches.cn: 电脑设备是挂在处理器那一圈上的配件。

branches.en: Vision has a sharp centre and a soft ring beyond it.
branches.cn: 视觉有一个锐利的中心，中心之外是一圈柔和的区域。

branches.en: Geography treats the far regions as the outer ring of a country.
branches.cn: 地理上把边远地区看作国家的外圈。

branches.en: Both the physical edge and low importance come from the same ring image.
branches.cn: 物理边缘与重要性低，都来自同一幅圆圈意象。

intro.en: Peripheral is an adjective formed from periphery, and the family includes the adverb peripherally and the related verbs.
intro.cn: peripheral 是由 periphery 构成的形容词，同族有副词 peripherally 以及相关动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin took periphereia from Greek with the same meaning of a circumference, and the adjective periphericus comes from it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语从希腊语借入 periphereia，仍指圆周；形容词 periphericus 由此而来。

items.example: The prefix peri- marks the ring around a centre.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 peri- 标示围绕着中心的一圈。

items.example: The root -pher- supplies the carrying motion of the ring.
items.exampleCN: 词根 -pher- 带来这一圈「环绕运转」的动态。

items.example: Periphereia names the outline of a circle.
items.exampleCN: periphereia 指出圆的轮廓。

items.example: Periphery is the noun behind the adjective.
items.exampleCN: periphery 是这个形容词背后的名词。

items.example: The suffix -al turns periphery into peripheral.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -al 把 periphery 变成 peripheral。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms peripherally.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 peripherally。

items.example: The suffix -ize builds peripheralize from the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ize 由这个形容词构成 peripheralize。

items.example: Peripheralize means to move something to the edge.
items.exampleCN: peripheralize 意为把某物推到边上。

items.meaning: in an outer or secondary way
items.example: Peripherally describes a marginal involvement.
items.exampleCN: peripherally 描述一种边缘性的参与。

definition_zh: 外围；周边；边缘；边缘地带
definition_en: the outer edge of an area, or the parts of something furthest from its centre
core_image: 一个圆：圆心之外那条走完一整圈的边线
scene: 新开的商场并没有出现在市中心，而是落在了城市最外侧的新城区。The new mall sits on the periphery of the city, not in the centre.
sceneCN: 这里 periphery 是「外围、边缘」（第 1 个义项：空间的边缘）；句意：这座新商场位于城市的外围，而不在市中心。

pos.zh: 外围；周边；边缘；边缘地带

collocations.phrase: the periphery of the field of vision

derivatives.zh: 名词加形容词后缀 -al 构成，义为「外围的；次要的」
peripheral 再加 -ly 构成，义为「在外围；次要地」

senses.title: The outer edge of an area
senses.definition: the outer boundary of a place, far from its centre
senses.definitionCN: 某地远离中心的边界区域
senses.example: The factory was built on the periphery of the town.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂建在镇子的外围。
senses.why: Greek periphereia names the line drawn around a circle, so the noun starts as the edge of any bounded place.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 periphereia 指围着圆画出的那条线，所以这个名词最初就是任何有界之地的边界。

senses.title: The far parts of a field of vision
senses.definition: the outer part of what an eye can see
senses.definitionCN: 眼睛能看到的范围里偏外侧的部分
senses.example: A car moved into the periphery of my vision.
senses.exampleCN: 一辆车驶入了我视野的边缘。
senses.why: The eye sweeps a circle of sight, and the noun naturally picks out its outer rim.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛扫出的视野本身就是一个圆，这个名词自然从中挑出外缘那一圈。

senses.title: Margins of a social or political order
senses.definition: the parts of a society or system that are least powerful or least involved
senses.definitionCN: 一个社会或体系中最无权力、最不居中的部分
senses.example: These writers have long worked at the periphery of politics.
senses.exampleCN: 这些作家长期在政治的边缘活动。
senses.why: If the centre holds the power, the ring around it holds the people and groups pushed away from decisions.
senses.whyCN: 如果中心握有权力，那么围绕中心的这一圈就是被推离决策的人物与群体。

intro.en: Periphery comes straight from late Latin peripheria, a borrowing of Greek periphereia, the circumference of a circle.
intro.cn: periphery 直接来自晚期拉丁语 peripheria，后者借自希腊语 periphereia，意为圆周。

items.en: Peri means around, and pherein means to carry, and later to revolve.
items.cn: peri 意为周围，pherein 意为携带，后来又有运转之意。

items.en: Periphereia means a circumference, the line that runs around a circle.
items.cn: periphereia 意为圆周，即绕圆一周的那条线。

items.en: Peripheria enters Latin and keeps the geometric sense of a boundary.
items.cn: peripheria 进入拉丁语，保留几何学上「边界」的含义。

items.en: Mathematics adopts periphery for the outline of a figure.
items.cn: 数学先采用 periphery 指图形的轮廓。

items.en: Geography, politics and computing extend periphery to any outer margin.
items.cn: 地理、政治与计算机领域把它扩展到任何外侧的边缘。

note.en: Periphery is the noun of the outer ring, with peripheral as its adjective and perimeter as a close geometric cousin.
note.cn: periphery 是表示外圈的名词，形容词是 peripheral，几何上的近亲是 perimeter。

entries.definition: on or near the outer edge
in a marginal way
expressed in a roundabout way
entries.definitionCN: 迂回表达的；绕圈子说话的

entries.definition: the outside limit of an object or area
the blank space at the edge of a page
the outer part of an activity or group

normalIntro.en: Periphery is the noun form of peripheral, and the pair centre and periphery runs through geography, politics and design.
normalIntro.cn: periphery 是 peripheral 的名词形式，中心与边缘这一对概念贯穿地理、政治与设计。

normal.en: Greek peri means around and pherein means to carry, so the periphery is what is carried around the centre.
normal.cn: 希腊语 peri 意为周围，pherein 意为携带，所以 periphery 就是被绕在中心周围的那部分。

normal.en: The phrase on the periphery of works much like on the edge of.
normal.cn: on the periphery of 这一搭配的用法和 on the edge of 很像。

normal.en: Centre and periphery form a fixed pair in geography and in political talk.
normal.cn: 中心与边缘在地理与政治讨论中是一对固定说法。

normal.en: The plural peripheries appears in phrases such as urban peripheries.
normal.cn: 复数 peripheries 常见于城市边缘之类的表达中。

normal.en: In everyday English, the phrase at the periphery of vision is rarer than the adjective form peripheral vision.
normal.cn: 在日常英语里，说「视野边缘」常用形容词形式的 peripheral vision，比单用这个名词更自然。

abstract.en: See a city with bright lights at the centre and dim rings at the outline.
abstract.cn: 想象一座城市，中心灯火通明，边缘一圈暗淡。

abstract.en: Imagine eyes that see sharply only ahead and only mistily around.
abstract.cn: 想象一双眼睛，只有正前方清晰，四周都模模糊糊。

abstract.en: Picture a hall where leaders stand in the middle and observers sit at the walls.
abstract.cn: 想象一间大厅，领导站在中央，旁观者贴着墙坐着。

examples.en: Many villages on the periphery of the capital still lack clean water.
examples.cn: 首都外围的许多村庄仍然缺少干净的水。

examples.en: The artist has spent years on the periphery of the art market.
examples.cn: 这位艺术家多年来一直处在艺术市场的边缘。

examples.en: Light and shadow at the periphery of the painting draw the eye outward.
examples.cn: 画作边缘的光影把视线引向四周。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泼瑞费瑞」——把水「泼」到圆的四周，花「费」就在外圈；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 peri（周围）+ pherein（携带、运转）→ periphereia（圆周）→ 晚期拉丁语 peripheria → 英语 periphery，核心义「绕中心一周的边界」。

sensesIntro.en: Periphery begins as the geometric outline of a circle, then becomes the outer zone of a place, of sight, and of a society.
sensesIntro.cn: periphery 先指几何上圆的轮廓，再引申为地方的外围、视野的边缘和社会的边缘。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the line that runs once around a circle.
core.cn: 核心意象：绕圆走完一整圈的那条线。

branches.en: The plain place sense is the outer zone of a town.
branches.cn: 最基本的空间义就是城镇外围的区域。

branches.en: Vision is a circle whose rim is the visual edge.
branches.cn: 视野是一个圆，圆的边缘就是视觉边界。

branches.en: People and groups off the centre come to be called the periphery.
branches.cn: 离开中心的人与群体被称为「边缘」。

branches.en: Both a town outer zone and the far range of sight are limits.
branches.cn: 城镇的外围和视线的远界都是「极限」之处。

branches.en: Whether a place or a group, the periphery is what lies outside the core.
branches.cn: 无论是地点还是群体，periphery 都是核心之外的部分。

intro.en: Periphery is built from Greek parts, and its family includes the adjective peripheral and the adverb peripherally.
intro.cn: periphery 由希腊语成分构成，同族包括形容词 peripheral 与副词 peripherally。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin borrowed Greek periphereia as peripheria with the sense of circumference, and English later took the adjective from Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁语把希腊语 periphereia 借为 peripheria，仍指圆周；英语后来又从拉丁语借入形容词。

items.example: The prefix peri- marks the ring around a centre.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 peri- 标示围绕中心的一圈。

items.example: The root -pher- gives the sense of motion.
items.exampleCN: 词根 -pher- 带来「运动」的含义。

items.example: The suffix -y completes the noun periphery.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -y 补全了名词 periphery。

items.example: Periphery is the base noun of this family.
items.exampleCN: periphery 是该词族的基础名词。

items.example: The suffix -al forms peripheral.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -al 构成 peripheral。

items.example: Peripheral describes things at the rim.
items.exampleCN: peripheral 描述处在边上的事物。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms peripherally.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 peripherally。

items.example: Peripherally marks a minor role.
items.exampleCN: peripherally 标示次要的角色。

items.meaning: nerves outside the brain and spinal cord
items.example: Peripheral nerves run away from the central nervous system.
items.exampleCN: 周围神经从中枢神经系统向外延伸。

definition_zh: 死亡；丧生；毁灭；腐烂；消失
definition_en: to die, or to be destroyed completely or ruined
core_image: 一场大火燃尽整片森林：有生命的东西在火里彻底消失
scene: 山火过后，山间小屋和屋后的松林都不见了，只剩灰烬。After the fire, the cabin and the pine forest behind it perished.
sceneCN: 这里 perish 是「毁灭、消失」（第 3 个义项：彻底毁掉或消亡）；句意：大火之后，山间小屋和屋后那片松林都毁了。

pos.zh: 死亡；丧生；毁灭；腐烂；消失

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -able 构成，义为「易腐烂的；易坏的」
现在分词形容词化，义为「严寒的；讨厌的」
动词加 -er 构成，口语中指「讨厌的家伙」
动词加 -ment 构成，义为「灭亡；丧生」，较少用

senses.title: To die, especially violently
senses.definition: to die, especially in a sudden, violent or harsh way
senses.definitionCN: 死亡，尤指突然、惨烈或艰难地死去
senses.example: Hundreds of people perished when the ship went down.
senses.exampleCN: 船沉时数百人丧生。
senses.why: Latin per- means through to the end and ire means to go, so perire is to go through to the very end of life.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 per- 表示「直到尽头」，ire 表示「走」，所以 perire 就是走到生命的尽头。

senses.title: To be destroyed completely
senses.definition: to be destroyed or lost completely, as objects or places
senses.definitionCN: 物体或地方被彻底摧毁、消失
senses.example: Most of the old records perished in the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分旧档案在洪水中被毁掉了。
senses.why: Once the path of going is taken to its end, anything can end, not only a person, so places and objects perish too.
senses.whyCN: 「一直走到头」这一路径一旦套用到别处，被走到尽头的不只是人，地方和物件也会 perish。

senses.title: To cease to exist
senses.definition: to come to an end and stop existing, as ideas, customs or languages
senses.definitionCN: 想法、风俗或语言走到尽头，不再存在
senses.example: Many local dialects have perished with the old generation.
senses.exampleCN: 许多方言随着老一辈人一起消亡了。
senses.why: The idea of reaching the end is extended to anything that can vanish, so a custom or a language can perish as well.
senses.whyCN: 「走到尽头」这一想法延伸到任何会消失的东西上，风俗或语言也就能够消亡。

senses.title: To rot or spoil
senses.definition: to decay or go bad, especially food in warm weather
senses.definitionCN: 腐烂变质，尤指天气温暖时的食物
senses.example: The fruit will perish quickly in this heat.
senses.exampleCN: 这么热的天，水果很快会烂掉。
senses.why: Food that goes bad has simply come to the end of what it can last, so a rotting apple perishes in the same sense.
senses.whyCN: 食物变质就是「保不住了」，一个烂掉的苹果也是在同一种「走到尽头」的意义上 perish。

intro.en: Perish descends from Latin perire, to be lost or to die, made of per-, meaning through to the end, and ire, meaning to go.
intro.cn: perish 源自拉丁语 perire（丢失、死去），由 per-（直到尽头）和 ire（走）组成。

items.en: Ire means to go, and per- means through, so perire is to go through and be lost.
items.cn: ire 意为走，per- 意为贯穿，所以 perire 意为「走过而丧失」。

items.en: Perire ranges over dying, being ruined and being lost.
items.cn: perire 兼指死亡、被毁和丢失。

items.en: The Old French descendant carries the sense of coming to ruin.
items.cn: 古法语中的后裔保留了「走向毁灭」的含义。

items.en: The verb appears in English for dying and for being destroyed.
items.cn: 中古英语里这个动词表示死亡与被毁。

items.en: The sense of food spoiling is added, and perishing later comes to mean bitterly cold.
items.cn: 「食物腐坏」的用法逐渐常见，perishing 也引申为「严寒的」。

note.en: Perish is the old and literary word for dying, close in form to perishable and perishing, and near in meaning to die, pass away and decay.
note.cn: perish 是表示「死亡」的古老而偏文学的词，形式上与 perishable、perishing 相近，意思上与 die、pass away、decay 相邻。

entries.definition: likely to decay or go bad soon
extremely cold, or very annoying
an annoying or troublesome person
to stop living
to disappear completely and suddenly
to decay and break down

normalIntro.en: Perish keeps the Latin idea of going through to the end, which is why it suits fires, floods and hard winters.
normalIntro.cn: perish 保留了拉丁语「一直走到尽头」的意思，所以很适合描述火灾、洪水和饥荒。

normal.en: Per- means through and ire means go, so perish is the final going.
normal.cn: per- 意为贯穿，ire 意为走，所以 perish 就是「最后的走」。

normal.en: Perish is stronger and more literary than die, and it usually hints at suffering.
normal.cn: perish 比 die 更强烈、更文学化，通常带有一层受苦的暗示。

normal.en: Perishable goods are things that go bad, where the ending is rot and not death.
normal.cn: perishable goods 指会腐坏的货物，这里的「尽头」是腐烂而不是死亡。

normal.en: Perished is both the past tense and the past participle of perish.
normal.cn: perished 既是过去式，也是过去分词。

normal.en: The proverb says that those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it, which is a warning about what perishes.
normal.cn: 有句谚语说：记不住过去的人注定重蹈覆辙，这正是一种关于「毁灭」的警告。

abstract.en: Watch a single flame die out behind glass.
abstract.cn: 看着玻璃后面的一小簇火苗慢慢熄灭。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden boat falling to splinters in the sea.
abstract.cn: 想象一只木船在海中碎裂成片。

abstract.en: See an old word fading until nobody can read it.
abstract.cn: 想象一个古老的词渐渐褪色，最后没人认得。

examples.en: Thousands of soldiers perished in the long winter campaign.
examples.cn: 数千名士兵在漫长的冬季战役中丧生。

examples.en: Fresh fish will perish within a day without ice.
examples.cn: 没有冰块，新鲜鱼一天之内就会变质。

examples.en: Much of the ancient art perished in the earthquake.
examples.cn: 许多古代艺术品在地震中毁掉了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「撇瑞史」——把生死一「撇」，写成历「史」；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 per-（贯穿、直到尽头）+ ire（走）→ perire（丢失、死去）→ 古法语 → 英语 perish，核心义「走到生命的尽头」。

sensesIntro.en: Perish moves from people dying, through things being destroyed and ideas vanishing, to food going bad.
sensesIntro.cn: perish 从人的死去，扩展到东西被毁、观念消亡，最后落到食物腐坏。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a forest fire burning everything to ash.
core.cn: 核心意象：一场大火把森林烧成灰烬。

branches.en: A person going to the end of life is the first sense.
branches.cn: 人走到生命的尽头，是这个词的第一义项。

branches.en: Objects and places that are ruined are also gone entirely.
branches.cn: 被毁掉的物件与地点同样彻底消失，是第二义项。

branches.en: Customs and languages reach an end and exist no longer.
branches.cn: 风俗与语言走到终点后不再存在，是第三义项。

branches.en: Dying and being destroyed share the same end of existence.
branches.cn: 死亡与被毁共享同一个「存在终止」的终点。

branches.en: Both vanishing and spoiling are endings, one for ideas and one for food.
branches.cn: 消亡与腐坏都是「终结」，一个属于观念，一个属于食物。

intro.en: Perish comes from the Latin verb perire, built from per- and ire, and its family includes perishable and perishing.
intro.cn: perish 来自拉丁语动词 perire，由 per- 与 ire 构成，同族有 perishable 与 perishing。

latinIntro.en: Latin per- means through or to the end, and ire means to go, giving perire, to be lost or to die.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 per- 意为贯穿、直到尽头，ire 意为走，合起来是 perire，意为丢失或死去。

items.example: The prefix per- adds the sense of going all the way.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 per- 增加「一直走到底」的意思。

items.example: Ire means to go.
items.exampleCN: ire 意为走。

items.example: Perire is the direct source of perish.
items.exampleCN: perire 是 perish 的直接来源。

items.example: Perir carries the Latin verb into French.
items.exampleCN: perir 把这个拉丁动词带进法语。

items.meaningCN: 借自古法语的动词词尾
items.example: The ending -ish in perish reflects Old French -ir.
items.exampleCN: perish 词尾的 -ish 反映古法语 -ir 的形态。

items.example: Perish keeps the sense of coming to an end.
items.exampleCN: perish 保留了「走到尽头」的含义。

items.example: The suffix -able forms perishable.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -able 构成 perishable。

items.example: Perishable is used for food that spoils.
items.exampleCN: perishable 用于会变质变坏的食物。

items.example: Perishing describes freezing weather in British speech.
items.exampleCN: perishing 在英式英语里描述冻人的天气。

items.example: The suffix -er forms perisher.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 构成 perisher。
